other_conditions: Must be enrolled as a regular student
Must have secured the first position at district level in Class 8, 10 or 12 examinations (Arts, Science or Commerce streams) conducted by the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education
Must have obtained at least 60 % marks in the respective examination
State‑level first position in Class 8, 10 (Praveshika) or 12 (Varishtha Upadhyay) examinations of the Sanskrit Education Department is eligible
First‑position at state level in vocational education examinations for Class 10 or 12 is eligible
Girl students from Swami Vivekananda Government Model Schools must have a CGPA of 9.0 or above in Class 10 or 12
Caste/category certificate submitted at the time of board examination will be treated as final
benefits_summary: One‑time cash prize up to ₹1,00,000 for top‑performing girl students, with an additional scooter for Class 12 awardees.
